tasks.title: الشاشة: صندوق المحادثات أطول من الشاشة فيُقص شريط الكتابة السفلي
tasks.brief: Reproduced: .wa-root height is calc(100vh - 120px) but the view starts at top ~146px (desktop) / ~162px (mobile) because of the PIN lock bar, so root bottom = 794 > 768 (desktop) and 886 > 844 (mobile) and the composer is cut off (d-wa-chat-big.png, m-wa-chat-big.png). Make the inbox view a flex column filling the viewport under the header (dvh, min-height safe), with .wa-root flex:1 and the lock bar counted in the layout; no clipped composer on 1366x768, 390x844 and short landscape. Frontend-only (index.html inbox block ~lines 6660-6790: unified-inbox renderWa/WA_CSS/draw). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required: extend tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs pattern (mock history API, no real PIN) with a new Playwright test under tests/ux/ and run it plus tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs and the existing unified-inbox unit tests; record exact results. Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-231.md and screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-231/; repro script tools/qa/qa-loop-231.mjs.
tasks.acceptance: On both viewports root bottom <= innerHeight and the composer is fully visible; test asserts it with the lock bar open and closed.

tasks.title: القائمة ترجع لأعلى عند فتح أي محادثة وعند زر الرجوع (ضياع المكان)
tasks.brief: Reproduced: scrolling the chat list to 600px then clicking a chat resets #waList scrollTop to 0 on desktop and mobile; on mobile the back button also returns to scrollTop 0 and the chat just left is not highlighted (backScroll). draw() rebuilds the entire view on every click. tasks.title: لوحة المفاتيح وقارئ الشاشة في المحادثات
tasks.brief: Reproduced (a11y step): #waSearch has no label/aria-label, active chat has no aria-current, #waList/#waMsgs have no role/aria-label, no aria-live for the loaded chat, lock button has no label; after a wrong PIN the field is cleared and focus goes to BODY, the PIN field is not focused on open, opening a chat leaves focus on BODY, Escape does not go back to the list on mobile, and the page has no heading. Add labels/roles, aria-current, focus the PIN field on open and after errors, move focus to the message pane/back button on open and back to the chat button on Escape/back, role=alert already on errors. Frontend-only (index.html inbox block ~lines 6660-6790: unified-inbox renderWa/WA_CSS/draw). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required: extend tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs pattern (mock history API, no real PIN) with a new Playwright test under tests/ux/ and run it plus tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs and the existing unified-inbox unit tests; record exact results. Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-231.md and screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-231/; repro script tools/qa/qa-loop-231.mjs.
tasks.acceptance: Keyboard-only flow works (Tab to PIN, Enter, arrow/Tab into list, Esc back); test asserts focus targets and aria attributes.

tasks.title: محادثة كبيرة (300+ رسالة): رسم كل الرسائل دفعة واحدة وبلا زر «انزل للأحدث»
tasks.brief: Reproduced: a 320-message chat renders 320 nodes in one draw (openBigChat ~480ms incl. mocked 250ms network) with scrollH 20k px; draw() always forces scrollTop to bottom, and after scrolling up there is no 'scroll to latest' button nor 'N new messages' marker. tasks.title: حالات الخطأ: 401 يظهر في الكونسول وخطأ الشبكة بلا زر إعادة محاولة وقائمة فارغة بلا شرح
tasks.brief: Reproduced: a wrong PIN logs 'Failed to load resource 401' in the console (acceptable) but the error text sits in the bar with no retry; a network failure/empty history ('conversations: []') shows only 'لا توجد محادثات' without explanation; the PIN input is cleared after a wrong attempt with no remaining-attempts or lockout hint. Add distinct empty/offline/error panels with a retry button, keep the typed PIN length hint, and map PIN_INVALID/PIN_REQUIRED/network codes to clear Arabic messages. Frontend-only (index.html inbox block ~lines 6660-6790: unified-inbox renderWa/WA_CSS/draw). Preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL UX. Backend frozen. No deploy. Tests required: extend tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs pattern (mock history API, no real PIN) with a new Playwright test under tests/ux/ and run it plus tests/ux/fix46-wa-history.mjs and the existing unified-inbox unit tests; record exact results. Evidence: .nova/qa/qa-loop-231.md and screenshots in .nova/qa/qa-loop-231/; repro script tools/qa/qa-loop-231.mjs.
tasks.acceptance: Empty, offline and wrong-PIN states have explicit copy and retry; test mocks 401, 500, network abort and an empty list.
